candidate.result_format: N identifies NUM8; the two hex digits are the eight-group pass bitmap.

numeric_contracts.division_zero: Quotient FFFFFFFF; remainder original numerator. No hardware divide instruction.
numeric_contracts.signed_division: Quotient truncates toward zero; remainder has numerator sign. INT_MIN / -1 explicitly wraps to INT_MIN with zero remainder; this is the test helper's defined policy, not a C-language claim.
numeric_contracts.multiply: Reference ROM __muldi3 receives a.low,a.high,b.low,b.high in r0..r3 and returns low64 in r0,r1. Products wrap modulo 2^64.
numeric_contracts.add_subtract: Unsigned two-word arithmetic modulo 2^64; software carry/borrow tests without PSR carry assumptions.
numeric_contracts.shift: Logical right shift; counts >=64 return zero.
numeric_contracts.round_divide: Unsigned nearest integer, ties toward positive infinity; remainder remains the unrounded divide remainder. Zero denominator follows the explicit sentinel contract.
numeric_contracts.hysteresis: Normalize previous state to 0/1. Off becomes on at value>=upper; on becomes off at value<=lower. Return new state and changed flag. Inverted thresholds return two FFFFFFFF sentinels. No load-control peripheral is touched.

limitations: The NUM8 user report supports the selected internal ROM entry, 54-byte runtime gate and the eight multiplication vectors on the current device. It does not establish physical ROM readback, other devices/ROM versions or a general C ABI.

SLEIGH omits CALL RETS assignment and multi-register stack work; explicit adapters retain the previously described matched-frame assumptions rather than independently proving general C ABI or hardware byte order.
Integer sentinel, wrap, shift and hysteresis semantics are explicit contracts of these bounded test helpers, not validation of production load control or C undefined behavior.
Actual PSR, interrupts, cache, full UI and task stack headroom are not modeled. Extra stack <=132 and APP growth 3200 match the user-passed BATCH8/ROM8 bounds.
The expanded Flash PC interval includes the original gap/data. No new boot, interrupt or exception handler is installed.
All 255 combined and per-vector table corruptions stay in computer memory. Register/guard changes are separately identified runtime-model injections, never emitted or flashed.
Only the About hook, Flash PC upper bound and appended APP code/data change. No persistent/calibration/output/Flash control APIs or production flashing allowlist changes are made.
